pr_title: fix: PWA not working after CRA@5 update
pr_body:
fix https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/6006

After upgrading to CRA@5, the PWA stopped working.

- I've also stopped prefetching i18n files (they're stills cached and served offline, but you must load them individually first)
- If a locale file fails to load, the app now falls back to default (English), instead of being stuck

issue_context.title: Excalidraw only working in when connected to internet.
issue_context.body:
I am opening the app when connected to internet. It works fine. 
Disconnecting from the internet> reloading the app or reopening, app says what chrome says when offline. 
I tried uninstalling and installing multiple times. With all data cleared.
Also the same thing when installing with other browsers like Edge, Brave.

review_comments: Also, the `fonts.css` file seems to require 2 loads before it's cached by SW. So if someone loads excalidraw.com and then goes offline, the fonts won't work 🤷‍♂️
